title: Stratified Payoff Labelling: multi-horizon RICE variant for token-econ workloads
creator: Mariana Lopez
description: Proposal for a new prioritization framework called Stratified Payoff Labelling (SPL), intended to extend RICE to better capture multi-horizon value and token-economics for Redwood Inference. SPL introduces a horizon stratification (H1: 0-3mo, H2: 3-12mo, H3: 12mo+) and a payoff label (Immediate / Deferred / Platform). Impact is computed per-horizon and discounted based on latency sensitivity and token-econ leverage. The goal is to produce a roadmap ordering that is: 1) more defensible to execs when trading off latency vs unit-cost, 2) actionable for Eng/Infra scheduling by grouping initiatives into similar horizon stacks, and 3) measurable with OKR-aligned metrics (tokens saved, p95 latency delta, revenue-at-risk avoided).
acceptance_criteria: SPL scoring calc implemented in a reproducible spreadsheet and GitHub notebook linked from PRD
Sample scoring applied to 30 candidate initiatives; ordering compared against canonical RICE and a cost-only sort
Playbook documenting how PMs assign horizon and payoff labels with examples and edge cases
Stakeholder review completed with Product, Infra, and Finance and at least one iteration of feedback incorporated
Two pilot initiatives selected for Q2 backlog conditioned on SPL ordering, with success metrics defined
decisions: Use three horizons rather than continuous discounting to keep scores interpretable to execs
Impact score will be split per horizon using a horizon-weight vector [0.55, 0.30, 0.15] by default; PMs can override with justification
Token-econ sensitivity multiplier applied to impact: initiatives that reduce per-token cost get a positive boost scaled to expected monthly token run-rate
Latency sensitivity penalty applied to initiatives that harm p95 latency unless mitigations are specified; latency-sensitive customer segments are captured as a label
Final numeric score = Weighted sum across horizons of (Impact * Reach * Confidence * HorizonWeight) adjusted by TokenMultiplier and LatencyPenalty
